m: A **word** that **names** things: a **noun**; also a **term**.
ex: “苹果”是一个名词。
"Apple" is a noun.
这个名词我从来没听说过。
I've never heard this term before.
use: Grammar term; 动词 = verb, 形容词 = adjective.

m: **Bank up earth** and **raise** young: to **breed**, to **nurture**.
ex: 他们培育出了新品种。
They bred a new variety.
学校要培育学生的创新能力。
Schools should nurture students' creativity.
use: For plants, animals, and people's qualities. Compare 培养 (train people).

ex: 今天新增了五个病例。
Five new cases were added today.
地铁明年新增两条线路。
The subway will add two new lines next year.
use: News style; 新增 + number + noun.

ex: 土豆俗称“洋芋”。
Potatoes are commonly called "yangyu".
这种病的俗称是“红眼病”。
The common name for this illness is "red eye".
use: Gives the everyday name beside the formal one.

m: **Han** (river) and **sunny** side: **Hanyang**, a district of Wuhan.
ex: 汉阳是武汉的一部分。
Hanyang is part of Wuhan.
我住在汉阳，每天去武昌上班。
I live in Hanyang and commute to Wuchang every day.
use: Wuhan's three parts: 武昌, 汉口, 汉阳.

ex: 这里的电力供给很稳定。
The power supply here is very stable.
学校给学生供给免费午餐。
The school provides students with free lunch.
use: Economics: 供给和需求 (supply and demand). Formal.

m: **As** a **result**, if you **say** so: **if we say**, **if**.
ex: 如果说他不对，你也有错。
If he was wrong, you were wrong too.
如果说北京是心脏，那长城就是它的骨头。
If Beijing is the heart, then the Great Wall is its bones.
use: Used to compare or concede; softer than 如果.

m: A **line** for one **special** use: a **dedicated line**, a **hotline**.
ex: 请拨打服务专线。
Please call the service hotline.
这是去机场的公交专线。
This is the dedicated bus line to the airport.
use: Phone hotlines and bus or rail routes.

ex: 我们对比一下这两张照片。
Let's compare these two photos.
两个人的性格形成了鲜明的对比。
The two people's personalities are in sharp contrast.
use: 跟…对比; 形成对比 = make a contrast. Close to 比较.

m: Someone **bewitched** by the **ball**: a **fan** of ball sports.
ex: 我爸爸是个足球迷。
My dad is a football fan.
比赛结束后，球迷们都很高兴。
The fans were all very happy after the match.
use: 迷 = fan: 歌迷 (music fan), 影迷 (film fan).

m: The **mouth** of a **window**: a **window**; a service **counter**.
ex: 请到三号窗口办理。
Please go to counter number three.
她坐在窗口看外面的风景。
She sat by the window looking at the view outside.
use: Also a computer window, and figuratively a "window" onto something.

ex: 这首歌的节奏很快。
This song has a fast rhythm.
大城市的生活节奏太快了。
The pace of life in big cities is too fast.
use: 生活节奏 = pace of life.

ex: 港口里停着几艘军舰。
Several warships are moored in the harbour.
这艘军舰是去年造好的。
This warship was built last year.
use: Measure word 艘.

ex: 我们要尊敬师长。
We should respect our teachers.
他当了五年的师长。
He served as division commander for five years.
use: Teacher sense is formal and respectful.

m: A **case** kept on the **file shelves**: a **file**, an **archive**.
ex: 公司有每个员工的档案。
The company has a file on every employee.
这些档案已经保存了一百年。
These archives have been kept for a hundred years.
use: 档案馆 = archives; 人事档案 = personnel file.

ex: 这个公式有两个变量。
This formula has two variables.
天气是这次比赛最大的变量。
The weather is the biggest unknown in this competition.
use: Maths and programming; also an uncertain factor.

ex: 他申请了一项专利。
He applied for a patent.
这项技术已经有专利了。
This technology is already patented.
use: Measure word 项. 申请专利 = apply for a patent.

m: An **echo** that **agrees**: to **respond to** a call.
ex: 大家都响应了这个号召。
Everyone responded to the call.
这个网站响应速度很慢。
This website is slow to respond.
use: For calls and appeals (号召); also tech "response".

m: A **touch** and a **drip**: a **little bit**; a medical **drip**.
ex: 他在医院打点滴。
He's on a drip at the hospital.
我会记住生活中的点点滴滴。
I'll remember all the little things in life.
use: 打点滴 = get an IV drip. 点点滴滴 = bits and pieces.

ex: 他每天向上帝祈祷。
He prays to God every day.
我的上帝，你怎么来了？
My God, how come you're here?
use: Christian God. Chinese gods in general: 神.

ex: 他的病加重了。
His illness has got worse.
这样做会加重孩子的负担。
Doing this will add to the children's burden.
use: With 病情, 负担, 语气 (stress one's tone).

ex: 国徽挂在大门上方。
The national emblem hangs above the gate.
国徽上有天安门和五颗星。
The national emblem shows Tiananmen and five stars.
use: Like 国旗 (flag), 国歌 (anthem).

ex: 我从中学到了很多。
I learned a lot from it.
他从中帮忙，事情才办成了。
Things only worked out because he helped in the middle.
use: Before a verb: 从中学到, 从中获利, 从中调解.

ex: 这个产品通过了认证。
This product has passed certification.
新用户需要先认证身份。
New users must first verify their identity.
use: 实名认证 = real-name verification.

ex: 这条运河很长。
This canal is very long.
京杭大运河是世界上最长的运河。
The Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal is the longest canal in the world.
use: Measure word 条.

m: The **spear point** that goes **first**: the **vanguard**, a **pioneer**.
ex: 他是改革的先锋。
He is a pioneer of reform.
年轻人应该做时代的先锋。
Young people should be the pioneers of their age.
use: Also avant-garde art: 先锋艺术.

ex: 他收了三个徒弟。
He took on three apprentices.
师傅教徒弟做菜。
The master teaches the apprentice to cook.
use: Opposite: 师傅 (master).

ex: 这条铁路横贯全国。
This railway runs across the whole country.
一条大河横贯这座城市。
A big river runs right across this city.
use: Written; for roads, rivers, mountain ranges.

ex: 考得好有奖励。
There's a reward if you do well in the exam.
公司奖励了他一万块钱。
The company rewarded him with ten thousand yuan.
use: Opposite: 惩罚 (punish).

ex: 今天买有优惠吗？
Is there a discount if I buy today?
学生买票可以享受优惠。
Students get a discount on tickets.
use: 优惠价 = special price; 优惠券 = coupon.

ex: 我们分工合作吧。
Let's divide the work and cooperate.
家里的分工很清楚，我做饭，他洗碗。
The division of work at home is clear: I cook, he washes up.
use: 分工合作 = divide work and cooperate.

ex: 他去上海出差谈商务。
He's on a business trip to Shanghai.
这家酒店主要接待商务客人。
This hotel mainly serves business travellers.
use: Before nouns: 商务舱 (business class), 商务部.

ex: 他四下看了看。
He looked all around.
四下里一个人也没有。
There wasn't a soul anywhere around.
use: Also 四下里. Literary; spoken is 到处 or 周围.

ex: 请把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。
Please throw the rubbish in the bin.
每天晚上我负责倒垃圾。
I'm in charge of taking out the rubbish every evening.
use: 倒垃圾 = take out trash; 垃圾分类 = sorting waste. Slang: junk, rubbish quality.

ex: 山坡上有很多羊。
There are many sheep on the hillside.
我们坐在山坡上看日落。
We sat on the hillside watching the sunset.
use: Measure word 个 or 片.

m: **Hit** with **weapons**: to **fight a battle**, to go to war.
ex: 他爷爷年轻时去打仗了。
His grandpa went to war when he was young.
没有人希望再打仗。
Nobody wants to go to war again.
use: Separable: 打了一仗, 打过仗. 打胜仗 = win a battle.

ex: 我们总算到家了。
We finally made it home.
等了三个小时，他总算来了。
After three hours of waiting, he finally came.
use: Shows relief after waiting. Close to 终于.

ex: 他们的步伐很整齐。
They marched in step.
我们要加快改革的步伐。
We must speed up the pace of reform.
use: Often figurative in news: 加快步伐.

ex: 我们避开了人多的地方。
We avoided crowded places.
早点出发，可以避开高峰。
Leave early and you can avoid the rush hour.
use: 开 shows moving away. Object: people, places, topics.

m: **Praise** a plan so it **succeeds**: to **approve**, to **agree with**.
ex: 我赞成你的意见。
I agree with your view.
赞成的请举手。
Those in favour, please raise your hands.
use: Opposite: 反对. Close to 同意.

ex: 我们会全力帮助你。
We will do our utmost to help you.
他用全力把门推开了。
He pushed the door open with all his strength.
use: 全力以赴 = go all out.

ex: 情况非常危急。
The situation is very critical.
在危急时刻，他救了一个孩子。
At a critical moment, he saved a child.
use: Formal; 危急关头 = critical juncture. Compare 紧急 (urgent).

ex: 多尔衮是清朝初年的摄政王。
Dorgon was regent in the early Qing dynasty.
电视剧里经常出现多尔衮这个人物。
Dorgon often appears as a character in TV dramas.
use: Historical figure; characters are chosen for sound.

ex: 请小声说话。
Please speak quietly.
她在我耳边小声说了一句话。
She whispered something in my ear.
use: Opposite 大声. 小声点儿 = keep it down.

ex: 他的级别比我高。
He ranks higher than me.
这是国家级别的比赛。
This is a national-level competition.
use: Used for job grades and levels of events.

ex: 这里到处都是黄土。
There's yellow earth everywhere here.
黄土高原在中国的西北部。
The Loess Plateau is in northwest China.
use: 黄土高原 = Loess Plateau.

m: **Not** **succeed**: **won't do**; at the end of a question, "can it be that?".
ex: 这样做可不成。
Doing it like this won't do.
难道你还怕他不成？
Don't tell me you're afraid of him?
use: Pattern 难道…不成 (surely not…?). Spoken.

ex: 她在出版社工作。
She works at a publishing house.
这本书是哪个出版社出的？
Which publisher put out this book?
use: Measure word 家.

m: Point a **finger** at a failed **duty**: to **criticise**, to **blame**.
ex: 别总是指责别人。
Don't always blame others.
他受到了很多人的指责。
He was criticised by many people.
use: Stronger than 批评; implies blame.

ex: 我们得想个法子。
We need to think of a way.
这个法子不错，试试吧。
That's a good idea, let's try it.
use: Spoken; same as 办法. Note neutral tone: fǎ zi.

ex: 他在中东工作了五年。
He worked in the Middle East for five years.
中东地区有很多石油。
The Middle East has a lot of oil.
use: Also 远东 (Far East).

ex: 他得到了应有的惩罚。
He got the punishment he deserved.
我们要给老人应有的尊重。
We should give the elderly the respect they deserve.
use: Formal; before a noun: 应有的尊重, 应有的作用.

m: A **place** to **handle** **matters**: an **office**, a branch office.
ex: 公司在北京有办事处。
The company has an office in Beijing.
你可以去街道办事处问问。
You can ask at the neighbourhood office.
use: Measure word 个 or 家. Often a branch or representative office.

ex: 记住这个公式。
Remember this formula.
用这个公式就能算出面积。
You can work out the area with this formula.
use: Maths and science; also a set pattern for doing things.

m: **Articles** that **cost** money and get **used up**: **consumer goods**.
ex: 手机已经成了日常消费品。
Phones have become everyday consumer goods.
今年消费品的价格涨了不少。
Consumer goods prices rose quite a bit this year.
use: Economics term; 奢侈品 = luxury goods.

ex: 诸葛亮是刘备的军师。
Zhuge Liang was Liu Bei's military adviser.
这件事你得给我当军师。
You have to be my adviser on this.
use: Spoken: a friend who gives you advice.

ex: 你考了多少分数？
What score did you get?
他太看重分数了。
He cares too much about grades.
use: Also maths fraction. Speech often just 分: 考了九十分.

ex: 他常年在外工作。
He works away from home all year round.
一个人在外，要照顾好自己。
When you're away from home on your own, take care of yourself.
use: 出门在外 = away from home. 除…在外 = except.

ex: 这次旅行收获很大。
I gained a lot from this trip.
农民正在收获玉米。
The farmers are harvesting the corn.
use: Figurative "gains" is very common: 有收获.

m: **Martial** and **loose** (also pine): **Wu Song**, a hero in Water Margin, a name.
ex: 武松打虎的故事很有名。
The story of Wu Song killing the tiger is famous.
小时候我最喜欢武松这个人物。
As a child, Wu Song was my favourite character.
use: Famous for killing a tiger with his bare hands.

ex: 地球有磁场。
The earth has a magnetic field.
这里的磁场很强，手机信号不好。
The magnetic field here is strong and the phone signal is bad.
use: Spoken slang: someone's "vibe" or aura.

ex: 他在建筑业工作。
He works in construction.
建筑业需要很多工人。
The construction industry needs many workers.
use: 建筑 = building; 业 = industry.

ex: 这里水陆交通都很方便。
Transport by water and land is convenient here.
这种车可以水陆两用。
This vehicle can be used on both land and water.
use: 水陆两用 = amphibious.

ex: 那个国家很快就灭亡了。
That country soon perished.
恐龙为什么会灭亡？
Why did the dinosaurs die out?
use: For states and species. Compare 消灭 (wipe out, transitive).

m: **Report** up and **report**: to **report to a superior**.
ex: 我马上去禀报大人。
I'll go and report to my lord at once.
有什么事要先禀报皇上。
Anything must first be reported to His Majesty.
use: Old-fashioned; heard in historical dramas.

ex: 你不能来，真遗憾。
What a pity you can't come.
没去长城是这次旅行最大的遗憾。
Not going to the Great Wall was the biggest regret of this trip.
use: 很遗憾 = unfortunately. Milder than 后悔 (regret one's own act).

ex: 我们分开走吧。
Let's go separately.
他们在一起十年，去年分开了。
They were together ten years and split up last year.
use: Also 分得开 / 分不开 (can / can't separate).

ex: 现在人的寿命越来越长。
People are living longer and longer now.
这种电池的寿命大概是五年。
This battery lasts about five years.
use: Also for machines and products.

ex: 历史书里讲到了专政。
The history book talks about dictatorship.
人民民主专政是宪法里的说法。
People's democratic dictatorship is a term in the constitution.
use: Political term.

ex: 他的狗死去了。
His dog died.
死去的人不能再回来了。
The dead can't come back.
use: Slightly literary. 死去活来 = half dead (from pain or grief).

ex: 他在查找史料。
He is looking for historical sources.
这些史料对研究很有用。
These historical materials are very useful for research.
use: 历史资料 is the full form.

ex: 医生警告他不要再喝酒。
The doctor warned him not to drink any more.
这是最后一次警告。
This is the last warning.
use: Pattern: 警告某人不要…. Stronger than 提醒 (remind).

ex: 他是一名军士。
He is a sergeant.
军士带着新兵训练。
The sergeant trained the new recruits.
use: Measure word 名.

ex: 这个视频太搞笑了。
This video is hilarious.
他总是喜欢搞笑。
He's always clowning around.
use: Spoken and informal. Compare 好笑 and 可笑 (ridiculous).

ex: 他工作过度，生病了。
He overworked and got ill.
不要过度使用手机。
Don't overuse your phone.
use: Before verbs or as a predicate. Different from 过渡 (transition).

ex: 我在下载一个电影。
I'm downloading a film.
这个软件可以免费下载。
This software can be downloaded for free.
use: Opposite 上传 (upload). Also pronounced xià zài.

ex: 皇帝召见了他。
The emperor summoned him.
校长召见了几位老师。
The headmaster called in several teachers.
use: Formal; a superior calls a subordinate. Also diplomatic summons.

m: **Plum** (a surname) and **crossroads**: **Li Kui**, a hero in Water Margin, a name.
ex: 李逵是个很勇敢的人。
Li Kui was a very brave man.
《水浒传》里的李逵脾气很急。
Li Kui in Water Margin has a hot temper.
use: Byword for a rough, hot-tempered man.

ex: 冬天真漫长。
Winter is so long.
经过漫长的等待，他终于回来了。
After a long wait, he finally came back.
use: For time and roads; more emotional than 长.

ex: 第一次世界大战开始于一九一四年。
World War One began in 1914.
他的爷爷参加过第一次世界大战。
His grandfather fought in World War One.
use: Short form 一战; World War Two is 二战.

ex: 现在是三点一刻。
It's a quarter past three.
我一刻也不想等了。
I don't want to wait a moment longer.
use: 三点一刻 = 3:15; 三点三刻 = 3:45.

ex: 你会解这个方程吗？
Can you solve this equation?
这道题要用方程来做。
This question needs to be done with an equation.
use: Also 方程式. 解方程 = solve an equation.

m: The **one who** holds the **brush**: **the author**, the present writer.
ex: 笔者认为这个说法不对。
The author believes this view is wrong.
这是笔者去年在北京的经历。
This is the writer's experience in Beijing last year.
use: Written; writers use it for "I" in articles.

ex: 这个节日源于中国。
This festival originated in China.
他的自信源于多年的努力。
His confidence comes from years of hard work.
use: Formal; 源于 + source.

ex: 房子是固定资产。
A house is a fixed asset.
公司去年的固定资产增加了。
The company's fixed assets grew last year.
use: Accounting term.

ex: 想不到你也在这儿！
I didn't expect you to be here too!
真想不到他会说这种话。
I'd never have thought he'd say such a thing.
use: Spoken; close to 没想到.

ex: 开车太久容易疲劳。
Driving too long easily makes you tired.
他感到身体很疲劳。
He feels physically exhausted.
use: More formal than 累. 疲劳驾驶 = driving while tired.

ex: 每个地方习俗不一样。
Every place has different customs.
春节吃饺子是北方的习俗。
Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a northern custom.
use: 风俗 is a near synonym.

m: **Check** and find **proof**: to **research** and verify (texts, history).
ex: 专家考证了这本书的年代。
Experts researched the date of this book.
这个说法还需要考证。
This claim still needs to be verified.
use: Academic. Also kǎo zhèng in slang: to study for a certificate.

ex: 这是一个难题。
This is a tough problem.
找工作是很多年轻人面对的难题。
Finding a job is a hard problem many young people face.
use: Measure word 个 or 道.

ex: 这座建筑物很高。
This building is very tall.
这里禁止在建筑物上写字。
Writing on buildings is forbidden here.
use: Formal; speech uses 楼 or 房子. Measure word 座.

ex: 她是一个很坚强的人。
She is a very strong person.
遇到困难的时候，你要坚强。
When you face difficulties, you must be strong.
use: Strong in character, not body. 坚强起来 = be strong.

ex: 他戴着一副墨镜。
He's wearing a pair of sunglasses.
夏天出门最好戴墨镜。
It's best to wear sunglasses when going out in summer.
use: Measure word 副.

ex: 犯错就要接受惩罚。
If you do wrong you must accept punishment.
老师没有惩罚他。
The teacher didn't punish him.
use: Opposite: 奖励 (reward). 处罚 is close, more official.

ex: 他的话激起了大家的不满。
His words stirred up everyone's discontent.
这本书激起了我对历史的兴趣。
This book aroused my interest in history.
use: Objects: 兴趣, 不满, 愤怒, 浪花.

m: **Tip** and lean at an **angle**: to **lean**, to **tilt**.
ex: 这座塔有点倾斜。
This tower leans a little.
政府向农村倾斜了更多资金。
The government tilted more funding toward rural areas.
use: Figurative: favour one side in policy.

ex: 学校每周一升国旗。
The school raises the national flag every Monday.
中国国旗是红色的。
China's national flag is red.
use: Measure word 面.

ex: 你会什么乐器？
What instrument can you play?
这些乐器都是从中国来的。
These instruments all come from China.
use: Measure word 件 or 种. Note: 乐 is yuè here.

ex: 政府要加强监管。
The government should tighten regulation.
这些食品没有经过监管部门检查。
These foods weren't checked by the regulators.
use: Formal, used for markets, food safety, prisoners.

ex: 这个沙发很舒服。
This sofa is very comfortable.
我今天不太舒服，想早点回家。
I'm not feeling well today and want to go home early.
use: 不舒服 = feeling unwell. Neutral tone: shū fu.

ex: 远处隐隐传来歌声。
Singing could be faintly heard in the distance.
我隐隐觉得有什么地方不对。
I had a vague feeling something wasn't right.
use: Often 隐隐约约 or 隐隐作痛 (dull ache).

ex: 气温在慢慢升高。
The temperature is slowly rising.
他的血压升高了，要注意休息。
His blood pressure has gone up; he needs to rest.
use: For temperature, pressure, levels. Opposite: 降低.

ex: 这件事影响深远。
This had a far-reaching impact.
这次会议具有深远的意义。
This meeting is of profound significance.
use: Almost always with 影响 or 意义.

ex: 算了，别说了。
Forget it, say no more.
太贵了，我们不买了，算了吧。
It's too expensive, we won't buy it, let's forget it.
use: Spoken. 算了吧 is softer.

m: **Cross** into the new **year**: to **celebrate Chinese New Year**.
ex: 你回家过年吗？
Are you going home for New Year?
过年的时候，孩子们最开心。
Children are happiest at New Year.
use: Separable: 过个好年 (have a good New Year).

ex: 这是一本学术刊物。
This is an academic journal.
他的文章在很多刊物上发表过。
His articles have appeared in many publications.
use: Measure word 本 or 种. Formal.

ex: 这是间接的原因。
That's an indirect cause.
我是间接听说这件事的。
I heard about it indirectly.
use: Opposite: 直接 (direct).

ex: 他一再说对不起。
He said sorry again and again.
医生一再提醒他别吸烟。
The doctor repeatedly reminded him not to smoke.
use: Before verbs; slightly formal. Close to 再三.

ex: 港口里有很多船只。
There are many vessels in the port.
大风天，船只不能出海。
On windy days, boats can't go out to sea.
use: Collective noun: no measure word or number. One boat: 一条船.

m: **Lose** money and **decrease**: a **loss**, to run at a loss.
ex: 公司今年亏损了。
The company made a loss this year.
这家店连续三年亏损。
This shop has lost money three years in a row.
use: Business term; opposite 盈利 (profit). Spoken: 亏了.

ex: 我去西欧旅行过。
I've travelled in Western Europe.
法国和德国都在西欧。
France and Germany are both in Western Europe.
use: 欧 = Europe (from 欧洲). Also 东欧, 北欧.

ex: 这只是我的主观看法。
This is just my subjective view.
你不要太主观了。
Don't be so subjective.
use: Opposite: 客观 (objective).

m: **Passed** on and **entering**: to **be introduced** from outside.
ex: 佛教是从印度传入中国的。
Buddhism came to China from India.
一阵音乐声从窗外传入。
Music drifted in through the window.
use: Written; for ideas, goods, sounds coming in.

ex: 这个方法很有成效。
This method is very effective.
改革取得了明显的成效。
The reform has produced clear results.
use: Formal; 取得成效, 有成效.

ex: 那时候生活很艰苦。
Life was very hard back then.
他们在艰苦的条件下完成了工作。
They finished the work under tough conditions.
use: For living or working conditions. Compare 辛苦 (tiring).

ex: 这个办法很高效。
This method is very efficient.
我们需要一个高效的团队。
We need an efficient team.
use: Formal; spoken: 效率高.

ex: 这家店很出名。
This shop is very well known.
她因为一首歌很快就出名了。
She quickly became famous because of one song.
use: Separable: 出了名. 有名 is a near word.

m: Pull along with a **band** so it **moves**: to **drive**, to **spur on**.
ex: 旅游带动了当地经济。
Tourism has boosted the local economy.
他的热情带动了大家。
His enthusiasm got everyone going.
use: Pattern: A带动B (A drives B).

ex: 猫在桌子底下。
The cat is under the table.
他在底下小声跟我说话。
He talked to me quietly down there.
use: Spoken; after a noun: 床底下 (under the bed). Close to 下面.

m: **Sand** **market**: **Shashi**, a district of Jingzhou, a name.
ex: 沙市在长江边上。
Shashi is on the Yangtze.
我们坐船经过了沙市。
We passed Shashi by boat.
use: Part of 荆州, Hubei.

ex: 他们的友谊很深厚。
Their friendship is very deep.
这个城市有深厚的文化底蕴。
This city has a rich cultural heritage.
use: With 感情, 友谊, 基础, 文化.

m: A **god** and an **immortal**: an **immortal**, a supernatural being.
ex: 他过着神仙一样的生活。
He lives like an immortal (carefree).
故事里的神仙会飞。
The immortals in the story can fly.
use: 神仙 often means a carefree, blissful life.

ex: 警察在追赶小偷。
The police are chasing a thief.
我们要追赶世界先进水平。
We need to catch up with world-class standards.
use: Also figurative: catch up with others' level.

m: One **above** who is **in charge**: a **boss**, a **superior**.
ex: 我的上司很严格。
My boss is very strict.
他跟上司的关系不太好。
He doesn't get on well with his boss.
use: Neutral tone: shàng si. Close to 领导 (more common in China).

m: **Take prisoner** a **prisoner of war**: a **captive**; to **capture**.
ex: 他们俘虏了很多敌人。
They captured many enemies.
那些俘虏后来都被放了。
Those prisoners were all released later.
use: Figurative: 俘虏了她的心 (won her heart).

ex: 他早年在国外留学。
He studied abroad in his early years.
早年这里还是一片农田。
Years ago, this was all farmland.
use: Written; speech: 年轻的时候 or 以前.

m: **Tie** a **knot** so it **becomes**: to **form** (an alliance, a pair).
ex: 他们结成了好朋友。
They became good friends.
几个国家结成了同盟。
Several countries formed an alliance.
use: Objects: 同盟, 夫妻, 朋友, 冰 (form ice).

ex: 他靠种水果致富。
He got rich growing fruit.
修路是农村致富的第一步。
Building roads is the first step to rural prosperity.
use: Slogan: 勤劳致富 (get rich through hard work).

ex: 经济分为几个部类。
The economy is divided into several sectors.
这些书按部类放在书架上。
These books are shelved by category.
use: Formal, technical; 类别 is more common.

m: A **thorn**-sharp **history** keeper: a **provincial governor** in old China.
ex: 他当过刺史。
He served as a provincial governor.
唐朝的刺史管理一个州。
In the Tang dynasty, a provincial governor ran a prefecture.
use: Historical title.

ex: 我们反对种族歧视。
We oppose racial discrimination.
这个国家有很多不同的种族。
This country has many different races.
use: 种族歧视 = racism. Note: 种 is zhǒng here.

m: The **foot** and **root** of a show: a **script**.
ex: 他在写电影脚本。
He is writing a film script.
这个视频的脚本是我写的。
I wrote the script for this video.
use: Also a computer script. 剧本 is a play script.

ex: 这不仅仅是钱的问题。
It's not just a matter of money.
学习不仅仅是为了考试。
Studying isn't only for exams.
use: Stronger than 不仅. Often followed by 还 or 也.

m: The **person** who **is** in the **matter**: a **party** concerned.
ex: 你应该问当事人。
You should ask the people involved.
当事人双方都同意了这个办法。
Both parties agreed to this solution.
use: Legal and formal; 双方当事人 = both parties.

m: A **country** in the **middle** of **developing**: a **developing country**.
ex: 中国是发展中国家。
China is a developing country.
很多发展中国家需要更多投资。
Many developing countries need more investment.
use: Opposite: 发达国家 (developed country).

m: **Spend** money like **waves** washing it away: to **waste**.
ex: 别浪费时间了。
Stop wasting time.
吃不完就打包，不要浪费。
If you can't finish it, take it away; don't waste it.
use: Also adjective: 太浪费了 (so wasteful).

ex: 我要好好回报父母。
I want to repay my parents.
这项投资的回报很高。
This investment has a high return.
use: 回报社会 = give back to society.

ex: 你们先行，我随后就到。
You go ahead; I'll be right behind.
这个城市是改革的先行者。
This city is a pioneer of reform.
use: Formal; 先行者 = pioneer.

ex: 我们要约束自己的行为。
We should restrain our behaviour.
这份合同对双方都有约束力。
This contract is binding on both parties.
use: 约束力 = binding force.

ex: 我喜欢旅行。
I like travelling.
我们下个月去云南旅行。
We're travelling to Yunnan next month.
use: 去…旅行. 旅游 stresses sightseeing.

ex: 直到十点他才回来。
He didn't come back until ten.
直到今天，我才明白他的意思。
Only today did I understand what he meant.
use: Often 直到…才… (only when… did…).

ex: 开车要谨慎。
You must drive carefully.
做这个决定以前要谨慎考虑。
Think carefully before making this decision.
use: Formal; 小心 is everyday.

ex: 请自带水杯。
Please bring your own cup.
这个手机自带很多软件。
This phone comes with lots of built-in apps.
use: Also "built-in, comes with".

ex: 艾滋病是一种传染病。
AIDS is an infectious disease.
很多人不了解艾滋病。
Many people don't understand AIDS.
use: 艾滋 is a sound loan; 病 marks a disease.

ex: 这个城市是改革的试点。
This city is a pilot site for the reform.
新政策先在三个省试点。
The new policy will first be piloted in three provinces.
use: Government term.

m: **Highest** and **healthy**: **Taikang**, a county in Henan, a name.
ex: 太康在河南东部。
Taikang is in eastern Henan.
我的老家在太康县。
My hometown is in Taikang County.
use: Also an era name of the Jin dynasty.

m: **Do** and **dress up**: to **dress up**, to get dolled up.
ex: 她每天都打扮得很漂亮。
She dresses up beautifully every day.
你今天打扮得这么好看，去哪儿？
You're all dressed up today, where are you going?
use: Neutral tone: dǎ ban. 打扮成 = dress up as.

ex: 银行在大楼西侧。
The bank is on the west side of the building.
公园西侧有一个停车场。
There's a car park on the west side of the park.
use: Written; speech: 西边.

ex: 村子在河谷里。
The village is in a river valley.
这个河谷四季都很美。
This river valley is beautiful all year round.
价格超出了我的预算。
The price went beyond my budget.
这个问题超出了我的能力范围。
This problem is beyond my ability.
use: Objects: 范围, 预算, 想象, 标准.

m: **Iron** rails under the **earth**: the **subway**, the metro.
ex: 我每天坐地铁上班。
I take the subway to work every day.
地铁站离这儿不远，走五分钟就到。
The metro station isn't far; it's a five-minute walk.
use: Verb: 坐 or 乘. 地铁站 = metro station.

m: Have it by your **self**: to **of course have**; **own**.
ex: 我自有办法。
I have my own way of handling it.
你别担心，他自有安排。
Don't worry, he has his own plans.
use: Confident tone. Also "self-owned": 自有品牌 (own brand).

m: **Run** a place of **learning**: to **run a school**.
ex: 这所学校办学五十年了。
This school has been running for fifty years.
政府鼓励社会力量办学。
The government encourages private groups to run schools.
use: Formal; 办学条件 = school facilities.

ex: 价格从十元到一百元不等。
Prices range from ten to a hundred yuan.
房间大小不等，有大有小。
The rooms vary in size: some big, some small.
use: Usually at the end: 从A到B不等.

m: A **mother** figure with **子**: **wife** (old); a young woman.
ex: 娘子，我回来了。
My dear wife, I'm back.
戏里的书生叫他的妻子“娘子”。
In the opera, the scholar calls his wife "niangzi".
use: Old-fashioned; heard in period dramas and operas.

m: **Untie** and **get rid of**: to **remove**, to **lift**, to **cancel**.
ex: 警报已经解除了。
The alarm has been lifted.
公司解除了跟他的合同。
The company terminated his contract.
use: Objects: 合同, 警报, 关系, 职务, 限制.

m: Those in your **unit**'s **category**: **subordinates**, troops under one's command.
ex: 他很关心自己的部属。
He cares a lot about his subordinates.
将军带领部属出发了。
The general set off with his troops.
use: Formal; 下属 is more common.

m: A small **thing** that the gun shoots like a **pellet**: a **bullet**.
ex: 枪里没有子弹了。
The gun is out of bullets.
那颗子弹差点打中他。
That bullet nearly hit him.
use: Measure word 颗 or 发.

ex: 这种布很有弹性。
This fabric is very stretchy.
我们公司实行弹性工作时间。
Our company has flexible working hours.
use: 弹性工作 = flexible working. Note: 弹 is tán here.

ex: 墙上挂着一本日历。
There's a calendar hanging on the wall.
我在日历上标出了考试的日子。
I marked the exam day on the calendar.
use: Measure word 本 or 张. Also the phone calendar.

ex: 北约有很多成员国。
NATO has many member states.
北约领导人下周开会。
NATO leaders meet next week.
use: Short for 北大西洋公约组织.

ex: 房子背后有一棵大树。
There's a big tree behind the house.
不要在背后说别人坏话。
Don't speak ill of people behind their backs.
use: 在背后 = behind one's back.

ex: 老师称赞了他的作文。
The teacher praised his essay.
大家都称赞她做的菜好吃。
Everyone praised her cooking.
use: More formal than 夸; 受到称赞 = be praised.

m: A **year** as a **portion** of time: a particular **year**; **vintage**.
ex: 这瓶酒是哪个年份的？
What year is this bottle of wine?
这些照片的年份已经看不清了。
You can no longer make out the years on these photos.
use: Used for wine, events, records.

ex: 他渴望成功。
He longs for success.
孩子们渴望得到父母的关心。
Children long for their parents' care.
use: Stronger than 希望. Object: noun or verb phrase.

ex: 她在演奏钢琴。
She is playing the piano.
今晚的音乐会有很多名家演奏。
Many famous musicians are performing at tonight's concert.
use: Formal; everyday: 弹钢琴, 拉小提琴. 演奏会 = recital.

ex: 人们高呼他的名字。
People shouted his name.
球迷们在场边高呼“加油”。
The fans shouted "Come on!" from the sidelines.
use: Written; for slogans and names.

m: A **big** **man**: a **burly fellow**; the great **Han dynasty**.
ex: 门口站着一个大汉。
A big burly man stood at the door.
两个大汉把箱子抬上了车。
Two strong men lifted the box onto the truck.
use: Measure word 条 or 个.

ex: 他们的弹药快用完了。
Their ammunition was nearly gone.
士兵们带着足够的弹药出发了。
The soldiers set off with enough ammunition.
use: Note: 弹 is dàn here.

ex: 这座桥是混凝土的。
This bridge is made of concrete.
工人们正在倒混凝土。
The workers are pouring concrete.
use: Spoken: 水泥 (cement) is often used loosely.

ex: 这种食物热量很高。
This food is very high in calories.
跑步一个小时能消耗很多热量。
Running for an hour burns lots of calories.
use: In diet talk = calories.

ex: 金钱不能买到幸福。
Money can't buy happiness.
他花了很多时间和金钱学画画。
He spent a lot of time and money learning to paint.
use: Abstract and formal; everyday: 钱.

ex: 上级下达了命令。
The superiors issued an order.
任务已经下达到每个部门。
The task has been passed down to every department.
use: Objects: 命令, 任务, 通知, 指标.

m: **Flood** **mountain**: **Hongshan**, a district of Wuhan, a name.
ex: 洪山区有很多大学。
Hongshan District has many universities.
我在洪山上过学。
I went to school in Hongshan.
use: A district in Wuhan.

ex: 远处山峰起伏。
In the distance, peaks rise and fall.
他的成绩起伏很大。
His grades go up and down a lot.
use: Also emotions: 心情起伏.

ex: 这种枪的射程很远。
This gun has a long range.
我们已经在敌人的射程以内了。
We're already within the enemy's range.
use: Military term.

ex: 每个教室都配备了电脑。
Every classroom is equipped with a computer.
公司给他配备了一辆车。
The company provided him with a car.
use: Formal; 配备齐全 = fully equipped.

m: The **head** and **brain**: a **head of state**, leader.
ex: 两国首脑举行了会谈。
The two heads of state held talks.
这次首脑会议在北京举行。
This summit is being held in Beijing.
use: 首脑会议 = summit meeting. News style.

m: A **civilisation** (**language** made **bright**) of the **spirit** (**essence** and **gods**): **cultural and ethical progress**.
ex: 我们要建设精神文明。
We must build cultural and ethical standards.
社区开展了精神文明活动。
The community held activities promoting civic virtue.
use: Political term; 物质文明 = material progress.

m: **Middle** **mountain**: **Zhongshan**, a city in Guangdong, and Sun Yat-sen's name.
ex: 中山离广州不远。
Zhongshan isn't far from Guangzhou.
很多城市都有中山路。
Many cities have a Zhongshan Road.
use: Honours Sun Yat-sen (孙中山).

ex: 他是这家公司的创建者。
He is the founder of this company.
这个网站的创建者只有二十岁。
The creator of this website is only twenty.
use: 创始人 is a near synonym.

ex: 火车站怎么走？
How do I get to the train station?
我们七点在火车站门口见。
Let's meet at the station entrance at seven.
use: Also 车站 for short.

ex: 他这会儿不在家。
He isn't home right now.
这会儿雨停了，我们走吧。
The rain has stopped now, let's go.
use: Spoken, northern. Also 这会.

m: **Ride** the **chance**: to **seize the opportunity**; to **take a plane**.
ex: 他乘机跑了。
He took the chance and ran.
请乘客提前两小时到机场乘机。
Passengers should arrive at the airport two hours before flying.
use: Two senses: opportunity and flying.

ex: 这个城市在内陆。
This city is inland.
内陆地区冬天比较冷。
Inland areas are colder in winter.
use: Opposite: 沿海 (coastal).

ex: 我家住在十一楼。
I live on the eleventh floor.
十一放假，我们去哪儿玩？
Where shall we go over the National Day holiday?
use: 十一长假 = National Day week off.

m: **Come** and **go back**: a **round trip**; **back and forth**.
ex: 他在房间里来回走。
He paced back and forth in the room.
从这儿到机场，来回要两个小时。
It's a two-hour round trip from here to the airport.
use: 来回票 = return ticket.

ex: 这件事削弱了他的地位。
This weakened his position.
长期熬夜会削弱身体的抵抗力。
Staying up late for a long time weakens the body's resistance.
use: Formal. Opposite: 加强.

ex: 他在县政府工作。
He works for the county government.
县政府门口停着很多车。
Many cars are parked outside the county government building.
use: Also 市政府, 省政府.

m: Go **up** on a **horse**: to **mount**; to **launch** (a project).
ex: 他跳上马就走了。
He jumped on the horse and left.
这个项目明年上马。
This project gets under way next year.
use: Figurative sense common for projects.

ex: 周末是休闲时间。
Weekends are leisure time.
他今天穿了一身休闲服。
He's wearing casual clothes today.
use: 休闲服 = casual wear; 休闲活动 = leisure activities.

ex: 她喜欢玩娃娃。
She likes playing with dolls.
这个胖娃娃真可爱。
This chubby baby is so cute.
use: 布娃娃 = rag doll. Neutral tone on the second wa.

m: A **meeting** where people **sit** and **talk**: a **forum**, a discussion.
ex: 下午有个座谈会。
There's a forum this afternoon.
学校召开了家长座谈会。
The school held a discussion meeting for parents.
use: Measure word 次 or 个. 召开座谈会 = hold a forum.

ex: 他在学书法。
He is learning calligraphy.
他的书法作品得了一等奖。
His calligraphy won first prize.
use: 书法家 = calligrapher.

ex: 那时候天下太平。
At that time the land was at peace.
人们都希望过上太平日子。
Everyone hopes to live a peaceful life.
use: Literary; 太平洋 = the Pacific Ocean.

ex: 这件衣服很好看。
This piece of clothing looks nice.
那部电影特别好看，你一定要看。
That film is really good; you must see it.
use: Different from 好听 (sounds nice) and 好吃 (tastes good).

ex: 他是市委常委。
He is a member of the municipal standing committee.
常委会今天开会。
The standing committee is meeting today.
use: Short for 常务委员(会).

ex: 这是给你的礼物。
This is a present for you.
你打算送妈妈什么生日礼物？
What are you going to give Mum for her birthday?
use: Measure word 件 or 份. 送礼物 = give a gift.

ex: 这是军用飞机。
This is a military plane.
很多新技术最早都是军用的。
Many new technologies were first used by the military.
use: Opposite: 民用 (civilian).

ex: 他是我们这儿的名人。
He's a celebrity around here.
很多名人都来参加了这个活动。
Many celebrities came to this event.
use: 名人故居 = former residence of a famous person.
